export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/kamal-automobiles) shows 987 total shipment records, latest cargo 2025-11-18, with the exact row: "2025-11-18 | KAMAL AUTOMOBILES | NEY AUTO SPARE | 32308 BEARING | NHAVA SHEVA SEA, India | Dar Es Salaam, Tanzania | 84821011 | BOL 8205708". Additional rows on the same date under the same BOL 8205708: HS 84828000 ("C J BEARING ASSY 88509 WOS") and HS 87089900 ("TURBO PACKING", "CMC 407 MJR KIT 29966903 TVS"). Buyer-side records also list consignees in Zambia (JAYN AUTO SPARES DEALERS AND SERVICES LTD, Solwezi; BHAARAT VEHICLE PARTS LIMITED, Lusaka) and DRC (JULIEN LENGE CHABALA, Lubumbashi). Source counter vs rows seen: page claims "Total Shipments 987 Records detected" and "Trading Partners 1 Known counterparties" / "Ports 2 Observed port lanes", but only 5 shipment rows and 5 buyer rows were actually rendered in the free view — the 987 figure is a platform counter, not verified row-by-row.
note: Exporter role confirmed by dated customs records: Nhava Sheva Sea -> Dar es Salaam (Tanzania), 2025-11-18, BOL 8205708, auto spare parts (bearings, packing, major kits). Declared HS 870840 (gearboxes) does not match the observed codes 84821011 / 84828000 / 87089900 — per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the actual HS should be corrected to the observed codes (verdict accepted_hs_corrected). Role: trader/exporter of auto spare parts (buys from Indian OEM-branded stock, ships to African buyers) — classify as trader, not manufacturer. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be retrieved: DuckDuckGo search returned a connection error on both attempts, and volza.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403. Therefore domestic_status = unknown, not none_found — absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not proof of no domestic supply. Revenue and export volume figures: null (not public in free views; the 987 counter is a shipment count, not a value). Address on record: Shop No.5, Maruti Chambers, Plot No.857/A, Kalamboli Warehousing — a shop/warehouse address consistent with a trading operation. No CIN/PAN published on the sources read; left null.
